purpose: Show that several grounded selections can describe one source map without defining canonical rooms.

examples.interpretation_boundary: This is evidence for local perceptual continuity across many implementation sectors, not proof of one perceived room.
A behavior membership can connect distant sectors and sprites; it is intentionally not an architectural or combat-space claim.
XY/Z overlap reveals a stacked-space candidate. It does not claim visual contact, walkability, or a balcony without renderer/runtime evidence.
One sector can contain multiple wall loops, so a sector ID/range is not itself a simple spatial-volume label.

conclusion: The hypotheses overlap and may disagree by task. An LLM should inspect their evidence and choose an interpretation rather than treating any selection as authoritative.
